starting-out-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
starting-out-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: Welcome to the museum of Varrock.

steps.player: Have you any interesting news?

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Yes, we found a rather interesting island to the North of Morytania. We believe that it may be of archaeological significance.

steps.player: Oh? That sounds interesting.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Indeed. We are making the final preparations for our voyage, in fact, you may be just the person we are looking for... Assuming you've got the necessary qualifications, that is.

steps.player: Would I qualify then?

steps.text: If the player has not completed The Dig Site:
If the player has completed The Dig Site but doesn't have enough Kudos:

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Although you do have the necessary qualifications, I'm not sure you're ready. Come back another time, and we'll discuss further.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Bone Voyage quest.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Yes indeed. You've helped us a great deal around the Museum and you have the necessary qualifications from the Earth Sciences exams.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: I have received word from the digsite that the canal has been constructed, and the barge is awaiting some final touches.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: The site foreman requested the aid of a qualified and experienced adventurer, and I believe you would be a perfect fit for the role.

steps.player: Sign me up!

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: That's great to hear. You should speak to the foreman at the digsite canal, I'll make sure he knows to expect you.

steps.player: I'm afraid I'm far too busy right now.

steps.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
steps.text: Fair enough, do let me know if you happen to change your mind.

options.text: Do you know where I could find any treasure?
How do I get a medallion?

the-finishing-touches-talking-to-the-bar.player: What can I do to help?

the-finishing-touches-talking-to-the-bar.speaker: Barge foreman
the-finishing-touches-talking-to-the-bar.text: Well, we've learned from our previous attempts that we need a sturdier type of wood to keep the barge afloat.

the-finishing-touches-talking-to-the-bar.speaker: Barge foreman
the-finishing-touches-talking-to-the-bar.text: However, magic logs had... well... peculiar side effects.

the-finishing-touches-talking-to-the-bar.speaker: Barge foreman
the-finishing-touches-talking-to-the-bar.text: Luckily, a new high-grade wood was discovered in distant Western lands, it would make the perfect material for the areas of the barge we need to reinforce.

the-finishing-touches-talking-to-the-bar.player: So you'd like me to bring you some of this wood?

the-finishing-touches-talking-to-the-bar.speaker: Barge foreman
the-finishing-touches-talking-to-the-bar.text: It's not quite that simple, I'm afraid. You'll have to talk to the sawmill operator at the Varrock sawmill to the North West, he will let you know what has to be done.

the-finishing-touches-talking-to-the-bar.player: Okay, I'll talk to the sawmill operator.

the-finishing-touches-talking-to-barge-f.text: Welcome back, [player name]. Have you retrieved the supplies yet?

the-finishing-touches-talking-to-barge-f.speaker: Barge foreman
the-finishing-touches-talking-to-barge-f.text: Well we need them to reinforce the barge, the sawmill operator can tell you what you need to do if you're unsure.

the-cursed-voyage-talking-to-the-barge-f.player: No problem. Is there anything else you need?

the-cursed-voyage-talking-to-the-barge-f.speaker: Barge foreman
the-cursed-voyage-talking-to-the-barge-f.text: The barge is prepared for the voyage, so I'm just about done here.

the-cursed-voyage-talking-to-the-barge-f.speaker: Barge foreman
the-cursed-voyage-talking-to-the-barge-f.text: Now that the barge is ready, you should probably talk to the lead navigator on board.

the-cursed-voyage-talking-to-the-barge-f.player: There doesn't seem to be a gangplank... How am I meant to get on board?

the-cursed-voyage-talking-to-the-barge-f.speaker: Barge foreman
the-cursed-voyage-talking-to-the-barge-f.text: The barge guard will happily help you on board. Just give him a prod!

the-cursed-voyage-talking-to-david.speaker: David

the-cursed-voyage-talking-to-john.speaker: John

the-cursed-voyage-talking-to-the-lead-na.speaker: Lead Navigator
the-cursed-voyage-talking-to-the-lead-na.text: Hello, I'm the lead navigator on the expedition, I take it you're here to help us out?

steps.player: Yep, that would be me.

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: Good, because we're going to need your help if we're ever going out on this voyage.

steps.player: What's wrong?

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: Well, you may be aware of the previous attempts at this expedition?

steps.player: No, what happened?

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: Well, the first barge had some serious design flaws... it didn't float.

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: The second barge suffered from 'feature creep'. Senior museum staff stuck their oar in and added unnecessary features: 'go-faster stripes', a portable fossil centrifuge and a walk-on mini-museum.

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: Needless to say, it had... buoyancy issues.

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: The third barge made it out to sea, but a special sealant was used that attracted sea monsters. They didn't make it very far.

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: The fourth also used a special sealant, this one attracted icebergs.

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: The fifth barge crashed into the sixth.

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: We lost the seventh one.

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: The eighth barge is still here, we think. An accident involving a magical explosion and some talking anchovies means that it is now believed to reside 12 seconds out of phase.

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: The ninth version was built using magic logs. The barge gained some form of rudimentary sentience. It developed serious depression and ran itself aground near Crandor.

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: So, now do you understand why we need your help?

options.text: I'm aware, no need to tell me about them.

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: So, now do you understand why we need your help?

steps.player: Um... Not really.

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: The voyage is clearly cursed!

steps.player: Oh... right...

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: Well, [player name], whether you believe it or not, know that none of my men will be going on this expedition unless you can ensure our safety from the curse.

steps.player: How am I supposed to do that?

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: We're not the first crew to face a cursed voyage, perhaps someone who has experienced one before can give you some advice.

steps.player: Any idea where I'd be able to find someone like that?

steps.speaker: Lead Navigator
steps.text: I've heard all kinds of stories at the Rusty Anchor Inn in Port Sarim. I'm sure you'll be able to find out something about cursed voyages if you ask around the folks there.

steps.player: Okay, I'll see what I can learn.
Maybe later.

steps.player: Ever made any cursed voyages?

steps.text: (Continues below from Jack Seagull's "Aye! I've sailed many..."

options.text: Can you help me get to Crandor Island?

steps.player: Ever made any cursed voyages?

steps.speaker: Jack Seagull
steps.text: Aye! I've sailed many a treacherous journey in my time! What it be to ye?

steps.player: I'm meant to be setting sail on a voyage of my own, but the crew won't go without some sort of 'protection'. I was hoping someone here would know of a way to avoid falling victim to the so-called curse.

steps.speaker: Longbow Ben
steps.text: There be nothing 'so-called' about curses, [laddie/lassie/young'un]!

steps.speaker: Jack Seagull
steps.text: Aye, 'tis a matter we take very seriously. Luckily, there are ways ye can avoid a curse.

steps.player: Great! What do I need to do?

steps.speaker: Jack Seagull
steps.text: Well that all depends on the nature of yer travels!

steps.player: We are heading out on an expedition to an ancient, previously unexplored, island for Varrock museum.

steps.speaker: Jack Seagull
steps.text: The museum aye? Ye be diggin' up bones and them sorts then?

steps.player: Well... I guess so.

steps.speaker: Jack Seagull
steps.text: Then the way I be seein' it, ye be needin' a lucky charm to do with that!

steps.player: A lucky charm to do with digging up bones?

steps.speaker: Jack Seagull
steps.text: Aye! I hear folk talking of an odd old man up in the quarry near Paterdomus who sounds as if he might deal in those sorts of things.

steps.speaker: Ahab
steps.text: Bahahahaha! This poor [laddie/lassie/young'un] is sailing a cursed voyage and ye be suggestin' lucky charms?!

steps.speaker: Jack Seagull
steps.text: What ye be gettin' at, Ahab?

steps.speaker: Ahab
steps.text: Listen here, [laddie/lassie/young'un]. There be no way out of a cursed voyage, however, there are ways one can make it through unscathed...

steps.speaker: Jack Seagull
steps.text: Aye, just like ye and yer leg, Ahab? Ahahaha!

steps.speaker: Ahab
steps.text: Take no notice of him. I just thought it be worth ye knowing all the options is all.

steps.player: Perhaps. What would I need to do to make it through the voyage 'unscathed'?

steps.speaker: Ahab
steps.text: Folk be tellin' tales of a special potion... A 'potion of sealegs' they be callin' it.

steps.player: A potion of sealegs?

steps.speaker: Ahab
steps.text: Aye. The crew simply drink the potion before they be settin' sail, and the next thing they know, they be safely at their destination!

steps.speaker: Jack Seagull
steps.text: Arrr! Magical potions? Be soundin' like nonsense to me!

steps.player: Well, I guess I'll talk to the navigators and offer both up to the crew to see which they'd prefer before I go gathering them up! Thanks!

steps.speaker: Jack Seagull
steps.text: Be off with ye then, and talk to them navigators! You're ruinin' me rum!

options.text: Have you got any quests I could do?

talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.speaker: Lead Navigator
talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.text: Welcome back, [player name]. Any luck finding a way for us to make it through this cursed voyage?

talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.player: Yes, I've got two options, actually.
The first is to use a good luck charm, something related to our expedition - a lucky bone from an odd old man in Paterdomus.
The second is a potion of sealegs, the crew would have to drink it at the start of the voyage.

talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.speaker: Lead Navigator
talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.text: Well I'm certainly not putting my crew's life in the hands of some lucky charm! I think I'll go with the potion.

talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.speaker: Junior Navigator
talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.text: I think the lucky charm sounds like a good idea...

talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.speaker: Lead Navigator
talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.text: Oh quiet, boy - you shouldn't believe in such nonsense.

talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.player: It's okay, I can get both.

talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.speaker: Lead Navigator
talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.text: Fine by me, as long as you get that potion.

talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.speaker: Lead Navigator
talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.text: The apothecary in Varrock might be able to help you out with that potion of sealegs, I'd start by paying him a visit.

talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.speaker: Junior Navigator
talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.text: Don't forget the lucky charm from the odd old man up in Paterdomus!

talking-to-bar-patrons-returning-to-the-.player: Okay, I'll be back once I've got the potion of sealegs and the lucky charm.

talking-to-bar-patrons-talking-to-lead-n.speaker: Lead Navigator
talking-to-bar-patrons-talking-to-lead-n.text: Any luck getting your hands on that potion of sealegs?

talking-to-bar-patrons-talking-to-lead-n.speaker: Lead Navigator
talking-to-bar-patrons-talking-to-lead-n.text: The apothecary in Varrock might be able to help you out, you should pay him a visit.

talking-to-bar-patrons-talking-to-junior.speaker: Junior Navigator
talking-to-bar-patrons-talking-to-junior.text: Hey, have you managed to get me that lucky charm?

talking-to-bar-patrons-talking-to-junior.speaker: Junior Navigator
talking-to-bar-patrons-talking-to-junior.text: The old man up in Paterdomus collects those sort of things, I'd see if he's going anything he's willing to give up.

talking-to-bar-patrons-talking-to-junior.player: Okay, I'll see what I can do.

talking-to-bar-patrons-talking-to-the-ap.speaker: Apothecary
talking-to-bar-patrons-talking-to-the-ap.text: I am the Apothecary. I brew potions. Do you need anything specific?

options.text: Can you make potions for me?
Have you got any decent gossip to share?

steps.player: Hi, I'm looking for an unusual potion to get my crew through a 'cursed' voyage.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Aha! Don't tell me... You want a potion of sealegs?

steps.player: Yes, actually. What's so funny?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: You'd be amazed at the nonsense these pirates believe! I'll let you in on a little secret, there is no magical potion to save you from the sea's wrath!

steps.player: Then what have you been giving those sailors?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: A simple herbal remedy containing vodka. Lots of vodka.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Look, if you bring me the ingredients, I'll make you the potion. It's not going to save your crew from sea curses, of course, but it'll certainly put their fears to rest!

steps.player: Well I don't really have a choice here, I need that potion. What ingredients do you need?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Two bottles of vodka and an unfinished marrentill potion, I already have everything else I require.

steps.player: Okay, I'll be back soon.

options.text: Have you got any good potions to give away?
